g.text: Bridge this jumper, "BOOST", to increase the max charge rate from 100mA to 500mA.

g.desc: Bridge this jumper, "BOOST", to increase the max charge rate from 100mA to 500mA.

g.text: Only do this if your battery is larger than 500mAh to avoid explosions, seriously.

g.desc: Only do this if your battery is larger than 500mAh to avoid explosions, seriously.

g.text: When P0.13 is set low, it will shut off power to the 3.3V VCC pin. This is useful to

g.desc: When P0.13 is set low, it will shut off power to the 3.3V VCC pin. This is useful to

g.text: reduce power usage from components that pull power while idle, such as RGB LEDs.

g.desc: reduce power usage from components that pull power while idle, such as RGB LEDs.
